name: comet-backup-mcp
description: Fleet-wide backup health, failure triage and usage reports for every tenant on your Comet Server, plus the admin API calls an MSP uses day to day.

comet_backup_password.title: COMET_BACKUP_PASSWORD
comet_backup_password.description: Admin account password (sent as AuthType=Password). Set COMET_BACKUP_SESSION_KEY instead to use a session key.

comet_backup_server.title: COMET_BACKUP_SERVER
comet_backup_server.description: Your Comet Server's host and port, for example backup.example.com:8060 (the CLI connects over https).

comet_backup_session_key.title: COMET_BACKUP_SESSION_KEY
comet_backup_session_key.description: Optional. Admin session key from AdminAccountSessionStart (sent as AuthType=SessionKey). Takes precedence over the password when set.

comet_backup_base_url.title: Comet Server full URL (optional)
comet_backup_base_url.description: Optional. The full https URL of your Comet Server, for example https://10.0.0.5:8060. Overrides COMET_BACKUP_SERVER when set. Leave blank to use COMET_BACKUP_SERVER. The admin login is only ever sent over https.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile. Leave blank for the default.

comet_backup_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
comet_backup_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools, refuse any state-changing execute call, and refuse the credential-tier reads. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

comet_backup_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
comet_backup_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

comet_backup_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
comet_backup_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to your Comet Server. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

comet_backup_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
comet_backup_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
